{{Top|leg}}
The '''Vine Runners''' was a squad of six [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] who were not only armed with [[Knife/Legends|knives]] and [[Spear/Legends|spears]], but who had also learned to use [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. They participated in the [[Skirmish on Endor (Recon-A)|Skirmish on Endor]] alongside with [[Recon-A]].
